Successfully completed the task of adjusting brightness and contrast in VLC media player. The following steps were performed:

1. Opened the Tools menu and selected Effects and Filters
2. Navigated to the Video Effects tab
3. Enabled the Image adjust checkbox to activate the video adjustment controls
4. Increased the brightness slider by dragging it to the right
5. Increased the contrast slider by dragging it to the right
6. Clicked Save to commit the adjustments
7. Closed the Adjustments and Effects dialog

The video is now playing with adjusted brightness and contrast settings that should better match the room lighting conditions. The changes have been saved and will persist for future video playback in VLC.
